item.title: The 51st State And A New Series Introduction [Rebel - Podcast for Cultural Engagement]
item.description:
This week the Rebels introduce their new upcoming series “the ditch on both sides”…   

P Nate and Pootie discuss a popular topic in the news, Trumps comments about annexing Canada economically so that we become the 51st state.  Despite how unrealistic this notion actually is, it has caused many to discuss whether this is good or bad for Canada.  How should Christians think about the topic and how does it highlight the principle foundation for our new series?
